subject.title: fix(auth-profiles): preserve secret refs and OAuth fields during doctor auth migration

question: Should this PR land as the doctor-owned migration fix for preserving SecretRef and OAuth material in legacy auth imports?
rationale: The code path is a persisted credential migration and handles sensitive auth material, so automation can verify the patch shape but maintainers need to own the upgrade/security boundary before merge.

options.title: Land after auth-owner review
options.body: Accept the focused parser-reuse fix once required checks and any rebase against overlapping auth migration work are complete.

options.title: Add shipped-shape coverage first
options.body: Require one more regression fixture from an observed shipped auth store shape before merge to reduce residual upgrade uncertainty.

options.title: Sequence with adjacent auth PRs
options.body: Hold only if maintainers want this field-preservation change bundled or ordered with https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/98245 or the broader runtime-import discussion.

recommendation.title: Land after auth-owner review
recommendation.body: Accept the focused parser-reuse fix once required checks and any rebase against overlapping auth migration work are complete.

likelyOwner.reason: The SQLite auth-store refactor and earlier flat doctor migration history make this the strongest available owner signal for the upgrade boundary decision.
